title: Jesus... The Ache Never Fully Left. 🩹
topic: he has carried an old ache all year, coping through his days but having downsized what he expects a new morning to change

bible.text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... the ache never fully left. 🩹

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I do my days anyway. I stopped expecting sunrise to fix it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: My rising carries healing in its wings. They arrive together.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Together? I thought healing came after enough time.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You will go forth and grow, the way calves do at morning.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Stop watching the calendar. Watch the east instead.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone still carrying an ache. 🩹
